feature: Accounting AR and AP project balance charts

flows.name: Review project-grouped financial position
steps: Confirm Accounts Receivable is grouped by project
Confirm Accounts Payable is grouped by project
Inspect project labels, totals, and ledger links at responsive widths

claims.description: AR and AP charts render project-group response data instead of aging buckets

Mobile chart hierarchy and labels are readable without overflow
